data.content_ref: inline:The relation is internally contradictory in kind. The target names a reduction ('reduces to') and then glosses it as 'a specialization or direct extension.' A 'specialization' is consistent with reduction (everything in the specialization is derivable from the general case). But a 'direct extension' by definition adds content beyond what it extends—exactly what the refutation condition proscribes ('refuted if it introduces claims... not derivable from the documented state'). So one of the two disjuncts the target offers as its relation description ('direct extension') is self-refuting under its own refuted-if clause. The target cannot coherently describe the same relation as both a reduction-to and a direct-extension-of the same artifact.
